dedupe_keys.name: dataset concerning the vibration signals from wind turbines in northern sweden

description: Dataset concerning the vibration signals from wind turbines in northern Sweden is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Luleå Tekniska universitet. In the manuscript, we investigate condition monitoring methods based on unsupervised dictionary learning. The dataset includes the raw time-domain vibration signals from six turbines within the same wind farm (near geographical location). All the wind turbines are of the same type and possess a three-stage gearbox. Coverage: a wind farm in northern Sweden. The publisher named on the listing is Luleå Tekniska universitet. Its keywords include Industrial Electronics, condition monitoring, wind turbine, Machine Elements, dataset. The listing shows 2026-04-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
